Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
import heapq

def kth_largest(values, k):
    if k < 1 or k > len(values): raise ValueError("k out of range")
    return heapq.nlargest(k, values)[-1]

assert kth_largest([3, 2, 1, 5, 6, 4], 2) == 5
```
explanation: A size-k heap-based selection avoids sorting all values. `nlargest` is roughly O(n log k) with O(k) storage; invalid k is rejected.
